apps.name: deepfake
apps.subtitle: Your music from YouTube Music, no ads
apps.localizedDescription: deepfake for iPhone: playlists, Liked Songs, Smart Shuffle, My Wave, lyrics, stats and Wi-Fi sync with deepfake on your computer.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Riff syncs your library with Riff on your computer over Wi-Fi.

apps.versionDescription:
Keeps up with your computer, and much more from it
• Keeps up with your computer: while deepfake plays there, the player here shows its song and time. Play takes over from that spot, and next, previous and seeking control the computer. The computer does the same while this phone plays
• Another try at opening deepfake from the lock screen player
• Wavy progress bar, its knob, text size and Clean up video titles (Settings, Interface); word-by-word lyrics as Gradient or Words (Settings, Lyrics)
• Lyrics cleaned up: no [Chorus] labels, dots where the music plays alone, backing vocals dimmed. Edit a song's lyrics, or time them by tapping along (the player's ••• menu)
• History (Your Library), songs pinned to Home, Home in your order and Liked songs in recommendations (Settings, Home)
• All nine sort orders in playlists, and Liked Songs first in Add to playlist
• Import from a YouTube, YouTube Music, SoundCloud or Apple Music link (the import button in Your Library), and plain YouTube as a search source
• A-B loop and speakers and headphones on the player; your own cover for a song; the computer's app icons (Settings, Interface)

Built from 87bfd30.

Built from 87bfd30.

Tapping the lock screen player opens deepfake
• The player on the lock screen and in Control Center now belongs to deepfake's own player, so tapping it should bring you into the app

Built from 05dddf8.

More word-by-word lyrics, fairer shuffle
• Lyrics timed word by word for more songs: KuGou is tried when Apple Music has none
• Shuffle with repeat on no longer starts the next round with a song that just played

Built from 0a2270c.

The computer's new features
• Lyrics timed word by word (from Apple Music): the line fills as each word is sung, on the lyrics screen and the card under the player
• Romanized lyrics: Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Russian and other scripts spelled in Latin letters under each line (Settings, Lyrics)
• Share lyrics as a picture: the picture button on the lyrics screen, tap up to 8 lines, then Share
• Listen together, in the player's ••• menu: start a room or join one by its code, with a phone or a computer, and hear the same song at the same time
• Headphone EQ (Settings, Sound): your headphones' correction from AutoEq, on top of your equalizer
• On this day on Home, Play discography on artist pages, and Copy song.link in a song's menu
• Search settings; search filters (Songs, Artists, Albums); Don't play this artist in a song's menu

Built from 64807a0.

Lock screen fixes, and sync brings more
• Dragging the lock screen's time bar to the end no longer plays on into another song: the song ends there, and the bar shows the song's real length
• Tapping the player on the lock screen or home screen should open deepfake
• Sync brings the songs you saved from album pages on the computer, and the sound it has on (its preset or effects)

Built from 3e6b036.

Share to Instagram story doesn't close the app
• Opening Share to Instagram story closed deepfake while it read the song; it reads it another way now
• Each step of making a story shows in Settings, About, Playback log, in case one goes wrong

Built from c2a143b.

Share to Instagram story
• A song's ••• menu has Share to Instagram story, as on desktop: pick 15 to 40 seconds of it, pick the look, and Share makes a video of the spinning record with that part playing
• The share sheet opens with the video (Instagram, Save Video); the song's link is copied for Instagram's link sticker

Built from 4704466.

Sound presets
• Desktop's presets (slowed + reverb, nightcore, speed up, distortion hard) in Settings, Sound and in the player's ••• menu
• Presets you saved on the computer come over with sync; Save current makes one here

Built from 790474d.

Pair with a QR code, and Sync with Spotify
• Point the Camera app at the QR code in deepfake's Settings on your computer, tap the banner, and the phone pairs: no address or code to type
• Playlists have Sync with Spotify, as on desktop: the playlist matches its Spotify namesake, in Spotify's order, with Undo

Built from 2ed4df4.

Remove duplicates
• A playlist or Liked Songs with the same song in it twice shows a Remove duplicates button under its search, with Undo

Built from 8d5202e.
